[1m[4mSource block language slot[0m
A language in the first slot still resolves when later slots hold other positional
attributes, so the block is highlighted. Split out of [38;5;14mblock_attribute_parity[39m because
highlighted output only exists under the [38;5;14mhighlighting[39m feature.
